test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five students A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). A is an immediate neighbour of both B and E. C is sitting to the immediate right of D. B is sitting to the immediate right of C. Who is an immediate neighbour of C and E?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Five students A, B, C, D, and E are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16093134561ac3b8b7774f55102ee9497324a51fd9eb9a4e79cde2566a7f6a6b.png] 

 
• A is an immediate neighbour of both B and E. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5159439dafe8d6596c5730aa8febb1272791c5d6723d1623ccbc594a63c7fc14.png] 

 
• B is sitting to the immediate right of C.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ce8b55eed2d0ff854f3cf9f09e75c186de83ef52342bce4ec6f8afcde645503.png] 

 
• C is sitting to the immediate right of D. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517172bcc839d30eb3fb549d02d9f679a35a1c56de6ffde12b15c62933482bda.png] 

So, **D **is the immediate neighbour of C and E.

Hence, **the correct answer is 'D'.**
